'''''The Starfighter Pilot's Handbook''''' was an introductory [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] document given to new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The document gave an overview of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] structure, the training process, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] systems, basic tactics and information on Rebel and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]].
